patch_description: Two improvements confined to the editable block: (1) full greedy — at each step evaluate ALL remaining transactions with the true makespan cost instead of a random sample of 6, making each greedy decision fully informed; (2) local search — after each greedy construction, apply random relocation/swap moves that reduce makespan until no improvement, repeated with randomized restarts under a time budget. Since `import time` cannot be added outside the block, it is imported inside the function.
